title: The Integrations settings section is present and hosts QuickBooks, IBS and Open API
preconds: 1. Log in as an Administrator with all Settings sub-toggles ON.
steps:
1. Look through the Settings area.
  2. Find the Integrations section.
  3. Look at what is inside it.
expected:
The Integrations section is present.

It contains QuickBooks, IBS and Open API.

Note: this reverses the old 'Integrations removed / QuickBooks moved to Finance' expectation — the live build keeps the Integrations section with QuickBooks inside it.
